## Description

"Where do you practise?" with India (Azure Central India · DPDP Act · ABDM integration available) and UAE (Azure UAE North · separate deployment · DoH/DHA/MOHAP per emirate) cards. Explains data stays in-country and cannot be moved later without a new account and export. "Continue in {region}" routes sign-up to that country's deployment; if a country is not yet live, it captures interest instead.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Selecting a region and continuing creates the tenant only in that country's deployment; tenant.country_code and residency_region are immutable afterwards (domain test).
- [ ] **AC2.** The residency explanation text matches the design and is translated.
- [ ] **AC3.** If the selected country deployment is not live, the user sees a waitlist form (no PHI) instead of sign-up.
- [ ] **AC4.** The selection is recorded in the onboarding audit trail.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
